name: Hedera Swiss Franc
oneLiner: HCHF is HLiquity's Swiss-franc stablecoin on Hedera, minted from overcollateralized HBAR troves via Liquity-style borrowing and Stability Pool liquidations.
collateral: HBAR locked in overcollateralized HLiquity Troves on Hedera, with a 110% minimum collateral ratio and Stability Pool liquidations
pegMechanism: Liquity-style borrowing protocol on Hedera: users mint HCHF debt against HBAR collateral, undercollateralized Troves are liquidated through the Stability Pool, and HCHF can be redeemed for HBAR collateral at face value to support the CHF peg

oracleRisk.summary: HLiquity values its sole HBAR Trove market through Pyth HBAR/USD and USD/CHF prices, falls back to Supra, and retains the last good price when both sources are unusable.

branchApplicability.rationale: HLiquity has one borrower-specific HBAR collateral market. Its oracle, 110% minimum collateral ratio, permissionless Trove liquidation, HCHF Stability Pool, redistribution fallback, and 150% Recovery Mode form one complete collateral-liquidation branch.

branches.label: HLiquity HBAR Troves
branches.summary: The sole HLiquity collateral branch prices HBAR in CHF through Pyth with Supra fallback and liquidates unsafe Troves through the HCHF Stability Pool or borrower redistribution.

feeds.path: Pyth HBAR/USD and USD/CHF composite, or Supra HBAR/USD and USD/CHF composite -> HLiquity PriceFeed -> Trove collateral ratio

branches.fallbackBehavior: The PriceFeed switches from Pyth to Supra when Pyth is broken, frozen beyond four hours, or deviates excessively without Supra confirmation. If both sources are broken or frozen, it returns the stored lastGoodPrice until a trusted source recovers.

collateralParameters.note: Normal Mode liquidates Troves below the fixed 110% MCR. Recovery Mode begins below 150% total collateral ratio and applies the documented ICR- and Stability-Pool-dependent cases.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Any caller can invoke the TroveManager liquidation functions without a protocol waiting period. In Normal Mode, HBAR Troves below 110% MCR are closed; HCHF debt is offset against the Stability Pool and seized HBAR is transferred to depositors.
branches.backstop: The HCHF Stability Pool is the first liquidation backstop. If its balance is insufficient, the remaining debt and HBAR collateral are redistributed proportionally across active Troves.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: HLiquity documents no global shutdown path. Empty or insufficient Stability Pool liquidity routes debt and collateral to active-Trove redistribution; Recovery Mode below 150% TCR broadens liquidation conditions while preserving the offset/redistribution waterfall.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Hedera Mirror Node metadata for HCHF token 0.0.6070123 reports no admin, freeze, wipe, or pause key. The non-null supply_key supports protocol minting against HBAR collateral in HLiquity's Liquity-style CDP system, but does not establish a holder-level freeze or arbitrary transfer restriction.

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-2 (lead buidl-blackrock)

sources.label: HLiquity token IDs, pools, and contracts

reserveReview.rationale: HCHF is issued by HLiquity, a Liquity V1 fork on Hedera developed by Swisscoast AG, and is backed solely by HBAR locked in per-user Troves whose collateral is held in aggregate protocol pools (ActivePool, DefaultPool, StabilityPool, CollSurplusPool, GasPool). The mirror node confirms token 0.0.6070123 with no admin, freeze, KYC, or wipe keys, and HLiquity's contract ownership is renounced, so the entire reserve is on-chain HBAR verifiable in real time; there is no fiat or off-chain component.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: HLiquity protocol design (single-collateral HBAR CDP) confirmed against Hedera mirror-node token and contract state
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No reserve asset class is unclassified; the only collateral is HBAR in protocol pools. Per-Trove collateral ratios vary by user, and aggregate coverage floats with the HBAR price.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: HBAR is an exogenous Layer-1 cryptoasset rather than a tracked stablecoin dependency.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Collateral is pooled in immutable, ownership-renounced protocol contracts rather than held by any bank or custodian, and it is not lent out by the protocol design. Legal segregation and bankruptcy-remoteness concepts do not map onto contract custody, so those fields remain unknown; Trove-level collateral is recorded per user in the TroveManager but held in aggregate pools.

sources.label: Hedera Mirror Node HCHF token state

mintAuthority.summary: HCHF is minted only when immutable HLiquity BorrowerOperations creates user debt against HBAR Troves. The HTS supply key decodes to fixed HCHFToken contract 0.0.6070122 rather than an external keypair, and that wrapper accepts mint calls only from fixed BorrowerOperations 0.0.6070094. The token has no admin, freeze, KYC, wipe, pause, fee, or metadata key, and every mint-critical contract has renounced ownership with no contract-update history.

controls.label: HLiquity HCHFToken and fixed BorrowerOperations mint path
controls.capDescription: No hard global supply cap. BorrowerOperations permits user debt only under the immutable 110% minimum collateral ratio, 150% critical collateral ratio, 1,780-HCHF minimum net debt, 20-HCHF gas compensation, and 0.5% borrowing-fee floor; HTS also applies its signed-int64 per-call bound.
controls.evidence: At Hedera block 97626563, token 0.0.6070123 had no admin, freeze, KYC, wipe, pause, fee, or metadata key. Its sole supply-key protobuf decoded to ContractID 0.0.6070122, also the token treasury. Exact HCHFToken source permits only fixed BorrowerOperations 0.0.6070094 to call mint. HCHFToken, BorrowerOperations, TroveManager, StabilityPool, and PriceFeed each had owner() = 0, self-referential ContractID admin keys, no modified timestamp, and no CONTRACTUPDATEINSTANCE history. Transaction 0.0.842806-1783066707-152111688 at block 97172682 traces a user adjustTrove through BorrowerOperations and HCHFToken into HTS mintToken, confirming the live path.

sources.label: Hedera Mirror Node HCHF token state

review.evidence: At the fixed cutoff, historical Mirror Node state and contract calls resolved the full HCHF mint path. The token's sole supply key is fixed wrapper contract 0.0.6070122, not an external signer; exact source restricts wrapper mint to fixed BorrowerOperations 0.0.6070094. All five checked mint, collateral, liquidation, and oracle contracts had renounced owners and no external update history. A real mint trace at block 97172682 follows user Trove adjustment through BorrowerOperations into the HTS mint precompile.
